chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from Abi al-Abbas, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When a man divorces his wife during his illness, she inherits him for as long as he remains in that illness, even if her waiting period has expired, except if he recovers from it. So I said to him, 'And if the illness prolongs with him?' He said, 'What is between it and a year.'
ai.seo_question: Does a divorced woman inherit from her ex-husband if he falls ill after the divorce?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the status of a divorced woman during her husband's final illness, establishing that she retains inheritance rights even after the iddah concludes, provided he does not recover. The limitation to one year for prolonged illness reflects the juristic consensus on the 'deathbed' period, ensuring the ruling applies specifically to the terminal phase of the disease rather than chronic conditions. This ruling underscores the Shia principle that the marital bond for inheritance purposes persists until actual death or full recovery, preventing premature disinheritance.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Abu Al Abbas, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘When the man divorces the woman during his illness, she inherits him for as long as he is in that illness even if she has fulfilled her waiting period, except if he were to become healthy from it’. So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘So if the illness prolongs with him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is between it and a year’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from abu al-‘Abbas who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

If a man during his illness divorces his wife she inherits him during that illness even if her ‘Iddah (waiting period) is complete unless he recovers from that illness.’ I then asked, ‘What happens if the illness prolongs?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is from that time (divorce) up to one year.’”
